analysis:
All four units are documentation-only changes: docs/architecture/inference.md (head excerpts at lines 2036-2604, outside the changed ranges 810-813, 829 and 876-880) and docs/developer/test.md (date bump plus new test-name descriptions at lines 173-180). The two inference.md units, which cover MiMo, Flash-Next, Flint and Bonsai text, are unchanged context, not new behavior. The changed hunks do not alter code, keys, attestation, authorization or encryption controls.

The inference.md hunks, seen only in the patch excerpt, change the GLM video docs. They say variable-frame-rate video is now indexed at i/nominalFrameRate instead of being refused as a 400. This implies a source behavior change in GLM5NextProcessor.decodeAsset. That source is not in this batch, so I could not verify it.

Possible security relevance: VFR videos now reach the decoder and tower. The existing bounds are still documented as unchanged. These are the 512 MiB decoded-frame cap, the 28,532 visual-token cap, media excluded from prefix cache lookup and capture, and the tower memory gates. T-041 is not affected: the media-noncacheable statement is retained and the SSD cache posture is untouched. Whether the code change preserves those bounds belongs to review of the source files, not to this documentation pass.

docs/developer/test.md only adds descriptions of OpenRouter reasoning-return and strict-tool replay tests. It has no security impact.

The threat model needs no update from these documentation changes. I found no regression, no new attack surface visible in the supplied evidence, and no invalidated assumptions.
